falsifier: Reject the local state neighborhood if earlier short protection at seventy-percent BTC volatility loses positive doubled-cost breadth or eliminates profitable short-role evidence.
formation_horizon: latest settled funding event standardized against forty-two prior events, with three completed price-confirmation bars and causal sixty-day direction plus seventy-percent thirty-day BTC volatility protection
hypothesis: If weak stress shorts drive the center result, beginning protection at seventy-percent annualized BTC volatility should preserve the edge across a modestly broader stress definition.
rebalance_horizon: daily cohorts with three-day confirmed-unwind and seven-day chop-extreme shadow portfolios
